content.title: Chapter 2 - ADMINISTRATION — Sec. 2-292. - Established.
content.summary:
There is hereby established a capital improvements fund in accordance with section
10.7
of the Charter. Accounts therefor shall be developed and maintained in accordance
               with generally accepted accounting principles.
(Code 1981, § 2-67; Ord. No. 2547, § 1, 8-15-1988)
